Before you start

Good to know.

What is Server Atlas?

A free mod for a clearer Minecraft Java server list. Discover public servers and manage favorites, notes, groups and your own addresses in Horizon.

Which platforms are supported?

Version 2.1.0 is available as a native Horizon .hnmod for Minecraft Java 26.3, tested on Windows x64. Fabric and Forge ports are planned and do not have downloads yet.

Do I rebuild at every launch?

No. Horizon builds native mods into a client once, then reuses that build. Changing the mod file or the enabled mod set requires a new build.

Are the website's servers live?

The website shows an address catalog dated November 3, 2026, without live player counts. The mod checks server status in the game. Joining also depends on version, authentication and server rules.

Are my own servers published?

No. Saved servers and notes remain local. Building the mod does not publish your server list. Feedback drafts stay local; automatic email delivery is not configured.
